chunks: Whatever is in it from Sulayman al-Daylami, I have narrated it from my father and Muhammad ibn al-Hasan—may Allah have mercy on them both—from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from 'Abbad ibn Sulayman, from Muhammad ibn Sulayman, from his father Sulayman al-Daylami.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; one of the immediate transmitters in the chain.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates the author’s act of narration through a sanad/isnad.
key_terms.سُلَيْمَانَ الدَّيْلَمِيِّ: Sulayman al-Daylami, the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Sulayman al-Daylami in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Sulayman al-Daylami. It serves as a chain-authentication notice in the book, identifying the intermediaries linking the compiler to the original narrator.
